comment: What the SimForge runtime is qualified on. The open CLI refuses 3D/schematic renders and rendered-sensor environments on a GPU outside `gpu` (gpu_unsupported, gpu_memory_unsupported, gpu_driver_unsupported) and picks the local texture default from `defaults`; simforge.ai/docs/render (apps/studio/app/docs/_content/render.md) renders this table. `measured` is the peak GPU memory of the render's own processes (nvidia-smi, 0.2 s samples) for one 3-second local render with four vehicles, on an RTX 5080 with driver 595.84, runtime 0.1.0, 2026-10-11, on the map releases installed on the measuring host (easterbrook-discovery-school: the distributed v9 pack); an RTX 3080 was not measured (every free one serves prod renders).

platform.comment: minGlibc is the runtime's floor (built on manylinux 2.28); cliMinGlibc is the published CLI's floor (built on the Ubuntu 24.04 build runners), so the installer refuses older systems by name.

unsupported: NVIDIA GPUs with less than 8 GiB
CPU Vulkan adapters, except an explicit --allow-software-adapter (slow, unqualified pixels)

tiers.fits: every public map, up to six 1920x1080 cameras

tiers.textures: bc7-512 by default; uastc-full fits every public map except san-ramon-phase-1 with one 1280x720 camera
tiers.fits: full textures need up to 8.1 GiB outside san-ramon-phase-1
every public map, up to six 1920x1080 cameras

textures.comment: A local 3D render or preview that names no --textures gets full textures on a GPU with at least fullTexturesMinVramGiB, else the `below` tier; the CLI passes it explicitly and reports it as `localDefaults` in the result.
